episode_row: deploy canary failed on the scheduler's auto-restart state

commits.subject: Allow clean scheduler completion in deploy canary
commits.body:
Allow clean scheduler completion in deploy canary

Treat the scheduler as healthy when it is active, or when systemd reports a clean Restart=always auto-restart cycle after day completion.

Keep rollback behavior for failed states and nonzero exits, and include scheduler state details in the canary failure reason.
